Hi!
I'm currently trying to build a model to estimate the concentration of a pollutant in a certain area and during a year, starting from daily samples from some stations. the model is a spatio temporal one, based on a matern spde for the spatial part, and on an autoregressive residual for time. the question is:
when I run the function result <- inla(....) it goes fine, and in the object result.summary$random there is a mean estimation of the pollution on the mesh nodes, for 364 days. How can I plot them?? And how is that matrix structured? The mean is a vector of mesh$n * time_stamps dimension: how do I decouple it and make as many plots as the days I considered? 
Thank you so much, I hope the question is clear, if not please tell me I'll try to be more precise.
Alessandro
